reproduction_acceptance: absolute mean difference <= 3 * sqrt(reported_se^2 + reproduced_se^2); same published input mapping, checkpoint, softmax sampling, sticky probability and episode cap
selection: highest development mean among three analytically constructed candidates; tie by lower penalty
primary_claim: selected model exceeds both 517.411 and the reproduced released reference checkpoint on the matched heldout game protocol; paired bootstrap mean-difference CI must exclude zero
construction: one-hot geometric trajectory features, previous observed paddle and vertical-direction recurrence, exact finite-horizon stochastic control dynamic programming compiled into fixed ReLU weights
no_training: no gradients, no sampled data fitting, no reward optimization of weights; candidate selection uses development feedback
fairness_limits: architecture, parameter count, recurrence and development-feedback budget differ from the original one-shot 600-32-32-6 tanh experiment
heldout_rule: freeze selection and weights before heldout; do not reuse heldout outcomes for further edits
